en: 7  The Object of Development
zh: 7  发展的对象

en: Open almost any study of Egypt produced by an American or international development agency and you are likely to find it starting with the same simple image. The question of Egypt’s economic development is almost invariably introduced as a problem of geography versus demography, pictured by describing the narrow valley of the Nile River, surrounded by desert, crowded with rapidly multiplying millions of inhabitants.
zh: 几乎打开任何一份由美国或国际发展机构撰写的埃及研究，你很可能会发现它都以同一个简单的意象开篇。埃及经济发展问题几乎总是被作为地理与人口之争的问题来引入，其描绘方式是描述那条被沙漠环绕、挤满迅速增殖的数百万居民的狭长尼罗河谷。

en: A 1980 World Bank report on Egypt provides a typical example. “The geographical and demographic characteristics of Egypt delineate its basic economic problem,” the report begins.
zh: 世界银行1980年关于埃及的一份报告提供了一个典型例子。“埃及的地理和人口特征界定了其基本经济问题，”报告开篇写道。

en: Although the country contains about 386,000 square miles, . . . only a narrow strip in the Nile Valley and its Delta is usable. This area of 15,000 square miles—less than 4 percent of the land—is but an elongated oasis in the midst of desert. Without the Nile, which flows through Egypt for about a thousand miles without being joined by a single tributary, the country would be part of the Sahara. Crammed into the habitable area is 98 percent of the population . . . . The population has been growing rapidly and is estimated to have doubled since 1947.
zh: 尽管该国拥有约386,000平方英里……只有尼罗河谷及其三角洲的一条狭长地带可资利用。这片15,000平方英里的地区——不到国土面积的4%——不过是沙漠之中一片狭长的绿洲。尼罗河在埃及流经约一千英里，没有一条支流汇入；若没有这条河，该国将是撒哈拉的一部分。可居住地区挤着98%的人口……人口一直在快速增长，据估计自1947年以来已翻了一番。

en: The visual simplicity of the image, spread out like a map before the reader’s eye, combines with the arithmetical certainty of population figures, surface areas, and growth rates to lay down the logic of the analysis to follow: “One of the world’s oldest agricultural economies,” a report written for the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) begins,
zh: 这一意象在视觉上的简洁——像地图一样在读者眼前展开——与人口数字、土地面积和增长率在算术上的确定性相结合，奠定了随后分析的逻辑：“世界上最古老的农业经济体之一，”一份为美国国际开发署（USAID）撰写的报告开篇写道，

en: Egypt depends upon the fruits of the narrow ribbon of cultivated land adjacent to the Nile and to that river’s rich fan-shaped delta. For more than 5,000 years agriculture has sustained Egypt. During the first half of this century, however, . . . the growth of agriculture failed to keep up
zh: 埃及依赖毗邻尼罗河的那条狭长耕地带，以及该河扇形沃饶的三角洲。五千多年来，农业支撑着埃及。然而在本世纪上半叶……农业的增长未能跟上

en: with the needs of a population which doubled, then nearly tripled. It is a matter of simple arithmetic . . .
zh: 人口的需要，人口先翻了一番，随后几乎增至三倍。这是一个简单算术的问题……

en: The popularity of this image of space and numbers is summed up in the World Bank report. “These two themes—the relatively fixed amount of usable land and the rapid growth of the population—will be seen as leitmotifs in the discussion of Egypt’s economic problems.”
zh: 这种空间与数字意象的流行，世界银行报告作了总结。“这两个主题——可耕地数量相对固定和人口快速增长——将被视为讨论埃及经济问题的主导动机。”

en: Fields of analysis often develop a convention for introducing their object. Such tropes come to seem too obvious and straightforward to question. The somewhat poetic imagery favored by writings on Egyptian development seldom lasts beyond the opening paragraph, and the text moves quickly on to the serious business of social or economic argument. Yet the visual imagery of an opening paragraph can establish the entire relationship between the textual analysis and its object. Such relationships are never simple. Objects of analysis do not occur as natural phenomena, but are partly formed by the discourse that describes them. The more natural the object appears, the less obvious this discursive manufacture will be.
zh: 分析领域常常为引入其对象而形成一种惯例。这类修辞格逐渐显得不言自明，无需质疑。关于埃及发展的著述所偏爱的略带诗意的意象，很少延续到开篇段落之后，文本很快转向社会或经济论证的严肃工作。然而，开篇段落的视觉意象可以确立文本分析与其对象之间的全部关系。这种关系从来不是简单的。分析的对象并非作为自然现象出现，而是部分地由描述它们的论述所构成。对象显得越自然，这种论述性制造就越不明显。

en: The description that invariably begins the study of Egypt’s economic development forms its object in two respects. In the first place, the topographic image of the river, the desert surrounding it, and the population jammed within its banks defines the object to be analyzed in terms of the tangible limits of nature, physical space, and human reproduction. These apparently natural boundaries shape the kinds of solutions that will follow: a more scientific management of resources, and new technologies to overcome their natural limits. The world is divided into nature and science, the material and the technological, a realm of objects and a realm of ideas. Yet the apparent naturalness of the imagery is misleading. The assumptions and figures on which it is based can be examined and reinterpreted to reveal a very different picture. The limits of this alternative picture are not those of geography and nature but of powerlessness and social inequality. What appears as nature is already shaped by forms of power, technology, expertise, and privilege. The alternative solutions that follow are not just technological and managerial, but social and political.
zh: 研究埃及经济发展时总是以这段描述开篇，它在两方面构成了其对象。首先，河流、环绕的沙漠以及挤在河岸之间的人口这一地形意象，以自然、物理空间和人类再生产的切实界限来界定有待分析的对象。这些看似自然的界限塑造了随之而来的解决办法类型：更科学的资源管理，以及克服自然限制的新技术。世界被划分为自然与科学、物质与技术、物的领域与观念的领域。然而，意象表面的自然性具有误导性。它所依据的假设和数字可以被检视和重新解释，从而揭示出一幅非常不同的图景。这幅另类图景的界限不是地理和自然，而是无力状态和社会不平等。看似自然的东西，已经由权力、技术、专业知识和特权的形式所塑造。随之而来的另类解决方案不仅是技术性和管理性的，也是社会性和政治性的。

en: In the second place, the naturalness of the topographic image, so easily pictured, sets up the object of development as just that—an object, out there, not a part of the study but external to it. The discourse of international development constitutes itself in this way as an expertise and intelligence that stands completely apart from the country and the people it describes. Much of this intelligence is generated by organizations such as the World Bank and USAID, which came to play a powerful economic and political role within countries like Egypt. International development has a special need to overlook this internal involvement in the places and problems it analyzes, and present itself instead as an external intelligence that stands outside the objects it describes. The geographical realism with which Egypt is so often introduced helps establish this deceptively simple relationship.
zh: 其次，这个如此容易想象的地形意象的自然性，把发展对象设定为恰恰就是那样一个对象——存在于外部，不是研究的一部分，而是外在于研究。国际发展论述正是以此把自己构造成一种完全独立于它所描述的国家和人民的专业知识和智力。这种智力有很大一部分是由世界银行和美国国际开发署之类的组织生产的；这些组织逐渐在埃及这样的国家内部发挥强大的经济和政治作用。国际发展有一种特殊需要，即忽视自身对它所要分析的地点和问题的这种内部卷入，转而把自己呈现为一种站在其描述对象之外的外部智力。埃及常常以之被引入的这种地理现实主义，帮助确立了这种具有欺骗性的简单关系。

en: Earlier chapters of this book have discussed a series of projects and forces that configured the Egyptian countryside in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, including the estate system and the law of property, irrigation works and epidemic disease, artificial fertilizer and industrial crops, the manufacture of heritage, and the importation of social science. The final part of the book turns to the end of the twentieth century.
zh: 本书前面几章讨论了一系列在19世纪和20世纪塑造埃及乡村的工程和力量，包括庄园制度与财产法、灌溉工程与流行病、化肥与经济作物、遗产的制造以及社会科学的输入。本书最后一部分转向20世纪末。

en: In 1973–74 the government of Egypt announced an “open door” economic policy (infitah), after almost two decades of close regulation of foreign investment and imports. The government’s ownership, funding, and management of large industry, trade, construction, and finance was now to be complemented by foreign and local private sector initiatives, often in partnership with state banks and enterprises. The significance of this change in policy should not be exaggerated. Economic relations had been formatted as a mix of government and so-called private processes since at least the creation of modern landed property, law, irrigation works, railways, policing, hygiene, and other networks in the nineteenth century, as we saw in chapter 2, and this formatting had gone through numerous crises and adjustments. The reforms of the last quarter of the twentieth century represented another series of adjustments, rather than any simple shift from “the state” to “the private sector” or, as it came to be known, “the market.”
zh: 1973—74年，在对外国投资和进口实行近二十年严格管制之后，埃及政府宣布“开放”经济政策（infitah）。政府现在要在大工业、贸易、建筑和金融的所有权、资金和管理之外，辅以外国和本国私营部门的举措，这些举措往往与国有银行和企业合作。不应夸大这一政策变化的重要性。至少从19世纪现代地产、法律、灌溉工程、铁路、治安、卫生及其他网络的创制以来，正如我们在第2章所见，经济关系就已被格式化为政府与所谓私营过程的混合，而这种格式化经历了无数次危机和调整。20世纪最后四分之一的改革代表了又一系列调整，而不是从“国家”向“私营部门”——或后来所称的“市场”——的任何简单转变。

en: One important part of this reformatting was the new role played in Egypt by the three Washington-based political agencies increasingly active across the postcolonial world, the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and USAID. These public sector agencies formed alliances with U.S. and other Western banks, corporations, government treasuries, and foreign ministries, and with a variety of forces within Egypt, both official and unofficial. They also met with resistance in Egypt, official and unofficial, and were seldom able simply to impose new policies, still less to control the outcome when their interventions were successful. Where they did achieve results, however, was in their monopoly of expertise.
zh: 这种重新格式化的一项重要内容，是三个位于华盛顿、日益活跃于整个后殖民世界的政治机构在埃及发挥的新作用：国际货币基金组织、世界银行和美国国际开发署。这些公共部门机构与美国和其他西方银行、公司、政府财政部和外交部，以及埃及国内各种官方和非官方力量结成联盟。它们在埃及也遭遇官方和非官方的抵制，很少能够简单地强加新政策，更不用说在其干预成功时控制结果。然而，它们确实取得成果的地方，在于对专业知识的垄断。

en: The final three chapters examine this expertise and its place in Egyptian politics. The current chapter examines the reforms of the 1970s and 1980s, and the way these were formatted as solutions to the problems of geography and nature in terms of which Egypt was always defined. Chapters 8 and 9 look at the crisis that followed at the end of the 1980s, and the remaking of the economy in the economic reforms of the 1990s.
zh: 最后三章考察这种专业知识及其在埃及政治中的位置。本章考察1970年代和1980年代的改革，以及这些改革如何被格式化为对埃及一向据以被界定的地理和自然问题的解决办法。第8章和第9章考察1980年代末随之而来的危机，以及1990年代经济改革中经济的重造。

en: too many people?
zh: 人口太多？

en: We can start with the common image of overpopulation and land shortage. Whenever you hear the word “overpopulation,” Susan George suggests, “you should reach, if not for your revolver, at least for your calculator.”

It is seldom clear, as she points out, to what the prefix “over” refers. What is the norm or the comparison to which it relates? “Egypt has the largest population . . . in the Middle East,” noted the World Bank report Trends in Developing Economies in 1989: “Its 52 million people are crowded into the Nile delta and valley . . . with a density higher than that of Bangladesh or Indonesia.”

Why Bangladesh and Indonesia? The World Bank might equally have mentioned Belgium, say, or South Korea, where population densities were respectively three and four times higher than Indonesia— but where the comparison would have had a less negative implication.
zh: 我们可以从人口过剩和土地短缺的常见意象开始。苏珊·乔治建议，每当你听到“人口过剩”一词，“你就算不去摸左轮手枪，至少也该去摸计算器。”
正如她所指出的，人们很少清楚“过”这个前缀指的是什么。它相关的常态或比较标准是什么？“埃及拥有中东……最多的人口，”世界银行1989年的报告《发展中经济体的趋势》指出，“其5,200万人挤在尼罗河三角洲和河谷……密度高于孟加拉国或印度尼西亚。”
为什么是孟加拉国和印度尼西亚？世界银行也完全可以提到比利时，比如说，或者韩国——那里的人口密度分别是印度尼西亚的三倍和四倍——但那样比较的负面含义就会小一些。

en: It is true that Egypt’s level of agricultural population per hectare of arable land was similar to that of Bangladesh, and about double that of Indonesia.

But this comparison is misleading, for arable land in Egypt is vastly more productive. It was estimated in 1986 that Egyptian agricultural output per hectare was more than three times that of both Bangladesh and Indonesia.
So it is not clear that Egypt was overpopulated in relation to either of these countries.
zh: 的确，埃及每公顷耕地的农业人口水平与孟加拉国相似，约为印度尼西亚的两倍。
但这种比较具有误导性，因为埃及的耕地生产力要高得多。据1986年估计，埃及每公顷农业产出是孟加拉国和印度尼西亚两国的三倍以上。
因此，并不清楚埃及相对于其中任何一国而言人口过剩。

en: Perhaps it would be more realistic to gauge Egypt’s land shortage by comparing it not with poorer countries but with places that had a similar total population and per capita gross national product, combined with far greater areas of cultivated land. The Philippines and Thailand were the two closest examples in population size and GNP and had cultivated areas three times and eight times that of Egypt, respectively.

Yet despite having far less land to farm, Egypt’s agricultural population produced more crops per person than either of these countries. Egyptian agricultural output per worker was perhaps 8 percent higher than that of the Philippines and 73 percent higher than that of Thailand.
zh: 也许更现实的做法是，不把埃及与更贫穷的国家比较，而是与总人口和人均国民生产总值相似、但耕地面积大得多的地方比较，以此衡量其土地短缺。菲律宾和泰国在人口规模和国民生产总值上是最接近的两个例子，其耕地面积分别是埃及的三倍和八倍。
然而，尽管可耕种的土地少得多，埃及的农业人口每人生产的作物却比这两个国家都多。埃及每个农业劳动者的产出可能比菲律宾高8%，比泰国高73%。

en: Despite the visual power of the image of more than 50 million Egyptians crowded into the valley of the Nile, there is no prima facie evidence for the assumption that this population was too large for its cultivable area. Perhaps it might be argued in more general terms that the world’s population is too large in relation to the earth’s limited resources.

In that case, however, there is no reason to single out Egyptians. On the contrary, Egyptians made very modest demands on the world’s resources (measured in terms of energy consumption per capita) compared with inhabitants of Western Europe, Japan, and North America. One inhabitant of the United Kingdom, for example, required more of the world’s energy per year than six Egyptians, and one American was more expensive in energy terms than a dozen Egyptians.
So it can hardly be the latter who were threatening the world’s limited resources.
zh: 尽管五千多万埃及人挤在尼罗河谷的意象在视觉上很有力，却没有初步证据支持这一假设：该人口相对于其可耕地面积来说过多。也许可以更笼统地论证，相对于地球有限的资源，世界人口过多。
但那样一来，就没有理由单挑出埃及人。恰恰相反，与西欧、日本和北美的居民相比，埃及人对世界资源的需求（按人均能源消费衡量）非常有限。例如，一个英国居民每年所需的全球能源比六个埃及人还多，而一个美国人在能源意义上比一打埃及人更昂贵。
因此，很难说正是后者在威胁世界有限的资源。

en: Perhaps it can be agreed that having more than fifty million inhabitants did not necessarily make Egypt “overpopulated.” Development experts might insist, however, that the problem was not the size of Egypt’s population but the rate at which it was growing. A report in 1976 by the United States Department of Agriculture asserted that the country’s “exploding population is the most serious problem facing Egypt today.”

The rapid growth in population appeared to have outstripped the country’s ability to feed itself, and in 1974 Egypt became a net importer of agricultural commodities. By the 1980s food accounted for almost 30 percent of Egypt’s merchandise imports, a higher proportion than for all except one of the one hundred countries for which figures were available.

It would appear from these figures that the case for an imbalance between population figures and agricultural resources had been established after all. But before accepting this conclusion we should reach, once again, for the calculator.
zh: 或许可以同意，拥有五千多万居民并不必然使埃及“人口过剩”。然而，发展专家可能会坚持，问题不在于埃及人口的规模，而在于其增长速度。美国农业部1976年的一份报告断言，该国“爆炸性的人口是埃及今天面临的最严重问题”。
人口的快速增长似乎超过了该国养活自己的能力，1974年埃及成为农产品净进口国。到1980年代，粮食占埃及商品进口的近30%，在有数据可查的一百个国家中，只有一国的比例高于埃及。
从这些数字看，人口数字与农业资源之间失衡的论据似乎终究已经确立。但在接受这一结论之前，我们应当再次去摸计算器。

en: not enough food?
zh: 粮食不够？

en: Between 1965 and 1980, according to World Bank tables, the population of Egypt grew at an annual rate of 2.1 percent. Yet during the same period, the World Bank also shows, agricultural production grew at the even faster rate of 2.7 percent a year. During the 1980s, when the population growth rate increased to 2.4 percent a year, agricultural growth continued to keep ahead.
In 1991, food production per capita was 17 percent higher than at the start of the previous decade.
So it is not true that the population was growing faster than the country’s ability to feed itself.
zh: 根据世界银行的表格，1965年至1980年间，埃及人口年增长率为2.1%。然而世界银行同时显示，同一时期农业生产以每年2.7%的更快速率增长。在1980年代，当人口增长率升至每年2.4%时，农业增长仍保持领先。
1991年，人均粮食产量比前十年的起点高17%。
因此，说人口增长速度超过该国养活自己的能力，并不属实。

en: If this is the case, then why did the country have to import ever increasing amounts of food? The answer is to be found by looking at the kinds of food being eaten, and at who got to eat it.
zh: 如果是这样，那为什么这个国家不得不进口越来越多的粮食？答案要从所吃食物的种类以及谁吃到了这些食物中寻找。

en: Official statistics suggest that Egyptians were consuming relatively large amounts of food. The World Bank ranked Egypt as a “low income” country in the 1980s, yet the country’s daily calorie supply per capita was estimated to be higher than all except one of the “lower middle-income” countries, and indeed higher than a majority of the world’s upper-middle and high-income countries.
The daily protein supply per capita also exceeded the level of most middle-income countries and rivaled that of many high-income countries.

Despite these figures, Egyptians suffered from high rates of undernutrition. A 1988 survey found that 29 percent of children suffered from mild undernutrition and another 31 percent from moderate or severe undernutrition.
Between 1978 and 1986 the prevalence of acute undernutrition may have more than doubled.
A study of anemia (probably caused by the interaction of malnutrition and infection) in Cairo found the condition in 80 percent of children under two years old and in 90 percent of pregnant women,
rates that the World Bank described as “alarmingly high.”
Clearly the high figures for calorie and protein supply per capita did not reflect the actual distribution or consumption of food.
zh: 官方统计表明，埃及人消费的粮食数量相对较大。世界银行在1980年代将埃及列为“低收入”国家，但据估计，该国人均每日卡路里供应量高于除一国外的所有“中低收入”国家，事实上还高于世界上大多数中上收入和高收入国家。
人均每日蛋白质供应量也超过大多数中等收入国家的水平，并与许多高收入国家不相上下。
尽管有这些数字，埃及人却遭受着高比例的营养不良。1988年的一项调查发现，29%的儿童患有轻度营养不良，另有31%患有中度或重度营养不良。
1978年至1986年间，急性营养不良的患病率可能增加了一倍多。
一项关于开罗贫血症（可能由营养不良与感染相互作用引起）的研究发现，两岁以下儿童中有80%、孕妇中有90%患有此病，
世界银行称这些比例“高得惊人”。
显然，人均卡路里和蛋白质供应的高数字，并未反映食物的实际分配或消费。

en: What the calorie figures probably reflected was high levels of food consumption among the better off, a shift in what they consumed toward more expensive foods, especially meat, and the diversion of food supplies from humans to animals. A World Bank study of agricultural pricing policy in Egypt in the 1980s noted that there was a very high variation in the value of food consumed between rich and poor, which it attributed to the low per capita level of income and its unequal distribution.

This inequality was already increasing from 1964/65 to 1974/75: in the countryside the share of household expenditure of the lowest 20 percent of households decreased from 7 to less than 6 percent in that decade, while in urban areas the share of the top 20 percent of households increased from 47 to 51 percent.

During the brief oil boom from the late 1970s to the mid-1980s, the income of the poor improved and the gap between low- and middle-income families may have narrowed. But the wealthiest 5 percent increased their income share between 1974/75 and 1981/82 from 22 percent to 25 percent in the case of rural households and to 29 percent in the case of urban.

In the late 1980s, as USAID and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) finally succeeded in imposing restructuring policies that removed price subsidies, increased unemployment, and brought economic recession, the degree of inequality almost certainly increased. A 1992 report on Egypt for USAID made clear that under these policies “losers necessarily outnumber winners.”While arguing that the increased poverty for the majority would occur only in the short term, the report admitted that there was no indication of any significant progress toward the long-term benefits this poverty was believed to bring.
zh: 卡路里数字可能反映的是较富裕者高水平的食物消费、他们的消费向更昂贵食物尤其是肉类的转变，以及粮食供应从人向动物的转移。世界银行1980年代关于埃及农业定价政策的一项研究指出，富人和穷人消费的食物价值差异极大，并将其归因于人均收入水平低及其分配不平等。
这种不平等在1964/65年至1974/75年间已在加剧：在农村，最低20%家户的支出份额在这十年间从7%降至不到6%，而在城市，最高20%家户的份额从47%升至51%。
在1970年代末至1980年代中期的短暂石油繁荣期间，穷人的收入有所改善，低收入与中等收入家庭之间的差距可能缩小了。但最富有的5%在1974/75年至1981/82年间提高了收入份额：农村家户从22%升至25%，城市家户从22%升至29%。
到1980年代末，随着美国国际开发署和国际货币基金组织（IMF）最终成功推行取消价格补贴、增加失业并带来经济衰退的结构调整政策，不平等程度几乎肯定加剧了。美国国际开发署1992年关于埃及的一份报告明确表示，在这些政策下，“输家必然多于赢家”。报告一方面声称多数人加剧的贫困只是短期现象，一方面承认没有任何迹象表明正朝着这种贫困据信会带来的长期好处取得重大进展。

en: Increasing wealth, together with increasing numbers of resident foreigners and tourists, led to a large increase in the demand for meat and other animal products, which were “chiefly consumed by tourists and other non-Egyptians, plus middle- and upper-class urban residents.”
A 1981/82 household survey showed that the richest 25 percent consumed more than three times as much chicken and beef as the poorest 25 percent.

In the subsequent oil-boom years, income growth together with extensive U.S. and Egyptian government subsidies encouraged a broader switch from diets based on legumes and maize (corn) to less healthy diets of wheat and meat products. From 1970 to 1980, while crop production grew in real value by 17 percent, livestock production grew almost twice as much, by 32 percent.
In the following seven years crop production grew by 10 percent, but livestock production by almost 50 percent.
To produce one kilogram of red meat requires ten kilograms of cereals, so feeding these animals required a large and costly diversion of staple food supplies from human to animal consumption.
zh: 财富的增长，加上常驻外国人和游客数量的增加，导致对肉类和其他动物产品的需求大幅增加，这些产品“主要由游客和其他非埃及人，以及中上层城市居民消费”。
1981/82年的一项家户调查显示，最富有的25%人口消费的鸡肉和牛肉是最贫困25%人口的三倍多。
在随后的石油繁荣年代，收入增长加上美国政府和埃及政府的大量补贴，鼓励了从以豆类和玉米为基础的饮食向更不健康的、以小麦和肉制品为主的饮食的更广泛转变。1970年至1980年，作物生产的实际价值增长17%，而畜牧生产的增幅几乎是其两倍，达到32%。
在接下来的七年里，作物生产增长10%，但畜牧生产增长近50%。
生产一公斤红肉需要十公斤谷物，因此饲养这些动物需要将大量昂贵的主粮供应从人的消费转向动物消费。

en: fodder for peace
zh: 用于和平的饲料

en: It was this switch to meat consumption, rather than the increase in population, that required the dramatic increase in imports of food, particularly grains. Between 1966 and 1988 the population of Egypt grew by 75 percent. In the same period, the domestic production of grains increased by 77 percent but total grain consumption increased by 148 percent, or almost twice the rate of population increase.

Egypt began to import large and ever increasing quantities of grain, becoming the world’s third biggest importer after Japan and China. A small proportion of the increase in imports reflected an increase in per capita human consumption, which grew by 12 percent in this twenty-two-year period. But the bulk of the new imports was required to cover the increasing use of grains to feed animals. Grain imports grew by 5.9 million metric tons between 1966 and 1988, to cover an estimated increase in nonfood consumption of grains (mostly animal feed, but also seed use and wastage) of 5.3 million tons, or 268 percent (see fig. 2).
zh: 正是这种向肉类消费的转变，而非人口增长，要求粮食尤其是谷物进口大幅增加。1966年至1988年间，埃及人口增长75%。同一时期，国内谷物产量增长77%，但谷物总消费量增长148%，几乎是人口增长率的两倍。
埃及开始进口大量且日益增加的谷物，成为仅次于日本和中国的世界第三大进口国。进口增长的一小部分反映人均人类消费增加了，这二十二年里增长了12%。但新增进口的大部分被用于满足越来越多的谷物用作动物饲料。1966年至1988年间，谷物进口增加了590万公吨，以覆盖估计增加的530万吨谷物非食用消费（主要是动物饲料，也包括种子用途和浪费），即增长268%（见图2）。

en: The dependence on grain imports after 1974 was caused not by population growth, which lagged behind the growth of domestic grain production, but by a shift to the consumption of meat. This shift was obscured, however, by the way different grains were used. Rather than importing animal feed directly, Egypt diverted domestic production from human to animal consumption. Human consumption of maize (corn) and other coarse grains (barley, sorghum) dropped from 53 percent in 1966 to 6 percent in 1988.

Human supplies were made up with imports, largely of wheat for bread making. So it appeared as though the imports were required not to feed animals supplying the increased demand for meat, but because the people needed more bread. USAID supported the shift to meat consumption among the better off by financing at reduced interest rates more than three billion dollars worth of Egyptian grain purchases from the United States between 1975 and 1988, making Egypt the world’s largest importer of subsidized grains. Yet the agency claimed that the purpose of these subsidies was “to help the poor.”
zh: 1974年后对谷物进口的依赖，并非由人口增长造成——人口增长落后于国内谷物产量的增长——而是由向肉类消费的转变造成。然而，这一转变因不同谷物的用途而被掩盖。埃及没有直接进口动物饲料，而是将国内生产从人的消费转向动物消费。玉米和其他粗粮（大麦、高粱）的人类消费量从1966年的53%降至1988年的6%。
人的供应靠进口来弥补，主要是用于制作面包的小麦。因此看起来，进口是为了给人民更多面包，而不是为了喂养满足日益增长的肉类需求的动物。美国国际开发署通过以降低的利率为1975年至1988年间从美国购买的价值30多亿美元的埃及谷物融资，支持了较富裕者向肉类消费的转变，使埃及成为世界上最大的补贴谷物进口国。然而该机构声称，这些补贴的目的是“帮助穷人”。

en: Subsidized American loans financed only a part of the grain imports. The rest required further borrowing, contributing to a total external debt that in 1989 reached $51.5 billion, a figure surpassed that year by only five other countries. Whereas the debt levels of the other five heavily indebted countries ranged between 22 and 95 percent of gross national product, Egypt’s debt amounted to 165 percent of its GNP.

Egypt began to default on the debt and required large loans just to keep up payments on its earlier loans. To address this crisis, the United States used the pretext of Egyptian support in 1990–91 for a war against Iraq to write off Egypt’s $7 billion military debt and to arrange for a relaxation of the remaining $28 billion of long-term bilateral debt, half of which was written off and half rescheduled.
As a condition of this refinancing, the United States insisted on a further shift toward export crops, away from staple foods, to produce more hard currency to pay the debts.
zh: 补贴性美国贷款只为谷物进口提供了一部分资金。其余部分需要进一步借贷，导致外债总额在1989年达到515亿美元，那一年只有五个其他国家超过这一数字。其他五个重债国的债务水平占国民生产总值的22%至95%，而埃及的债务相当于其国民生产总值的165%。
埃及开始违约，需要大量贷款仅仅为了偿还早先贷款的款项。为应对这一危机，美国利用埃及在1990—91年对伊拉克战争中的支持为借口，注销了埃及70亿美元的军事债务，并安排放宽其余280亿美元长期双边债务的偿还条件，其中一半被注销，一半重新安排。
作为重新融资的条件，美国坚持进一步转向出口作物、放弃主粮，以生产更多硬通货来偿还债务。

en: Figure 2. Supply and consumption of grains in Egypt, 1966–90. Source: Calculated from USAID, Status Report (Cairo, 1989).
zh: 图2. 埃及的谷物供应与消费，1966—90年。资料来源：根据 USAID, Status Report (Cairo, 1989) 计算。
〔图内文字译释：图内：纵轴为百万吨；图例依次为人类消费、非食用用途、国内生产。〕

en: The transformation in food consumption habits affected not only agricultural imports and the balance of payments, but also domestic agriculture. By the 1980s it was no longer accurate to write that Egyptian capitalist agriculture “still is to a large extent the cultivation of cotton.”
In terms of the commitment of land and labor, the priority was now the production of meat, poultry, and dairy products. In 1989 cotton occupied only about one million of Egypt’s six million acres.

The other major industrial crop, sugarcane, occupied a little over a quarter of a million acres. Of the remaining four and three-quarter million acres, more than half was used to grow animal fodder—principally Egyptian clover (berseem) in the winter and maize and sorghum in the summer and autumn.
Egypt was now growing more food for animals to consume than for humans.
zh: 食物消费习惯的转变不仅影响农业进口和国际收支，也影响国内农业。到1980年代，再把埃及资本主义农业写成“在很大程度上仍然是棉花种植”已不再准确。
就土地和劳动力的投入而言，现在的优先事项是肉类、家禽和乳制品的生产。1989年，棉花仅占埃及600万费丹中的约100万费丹。
另一种主要经济作物甘蔗占地略多于25万费丹。在其余475万费丹中，一半以上用于种植动物饲料——主要是冬季的亚历山大车轴草（berseem）和夏季与秋季的玉米与高粱。
埃及现在为动物消费而种植的粮食比为人消费的还多。

en: The shift to the production of meat and other animal products (which was accompanied by an increased production of other more expensive, nonstaple agricultural products, particularly fruit and vegetables) had two principal causes. First, as the World Bank put it,“effective demand has been modified by a change in income distribution.”

In other words, the growing disparity in income between rich and poor enabled the better off to divert the country’s resources from the production of staples to the production of luxury items. Second, the Egyptian government, supported by the large American loans already mentioned (called “Food For Peace”), encouraged this diversion by subsidizing the import of staples for consumers, heavily taxing the production of staples by farmers, and subsidizing the production of meat, poultry, and dairy products.
Livestock raising was particularly concentrated on large farms, those over ten acres, where there were three to four times as many cattle per acre as on farms of one to ten acres.

Yet government food policy forced even the smallest farmers to shift from self-provisioning to the production of animal products and to rely increasingly on subsidized imported flour for their staple diet.
zh: 向肉类和其他动物产品生产的转变（伴随着其他更昂贵的非主粮农产品尤其是水果和蔬菜产量的增加）有两个主要原因。首先，用世界银行的话说，“有效需求因收入分配的变化而改变。”
换言之，贫富之间日益扩大的收入差距使较富裕者能够将该国资源从主粮生产转向奢侈品生产。其次，埃及政府在已经提到的美国大额贷款（名为“粮食用于和平”）支持下，通过补贴消费者的主粮进口、对农民的主粮生产课以重税、并补贴肉类、家禽和乳制品生产，鼓励了这种转移。
畜牧饲养尤其集中在十费丹以上的大农场，那里每费丹的牛数量是1至10费丹农场的三到四倍。
然而，政府的粮食政策迫使即使是最小的农民也从自给自足转向动物产品生产，并日益依赖补贴进口面粉作为其主食。

en: The image of a vast population packed within a limited agricultural area and increasing in size at a rate that outpaced its ability to feed itself is therefore quite misleading. The growth in agricultural production was always ahead of population growth. Egypt’s food problem was the result not of too many people occupying too little land, but of the power of a certain part of that population, supported by the prevailing domestic and international regime, to shift the country’s resources from staple foods to more expensive items of consumption.
zh: 因此，关于一个庞大人口挤在有限农业区内、其增长速度超过自身供养能力的意象，相当具误导性。农业生产的增长始终领先于人口增长。埃及的粮食问题不是太多人占据太少土地的结果，而是该人口中某一部分人的权力的结果——这部分人在通行的国内和国际体制支持下，有能力把国家的资源从主粮转向更昂贵的消费项目。

en: Population growth rates of over 2.5 percent a year, some might argue, were nevertheless still very high. Surely it would have been better to produce fewer children and more buffaloes, cows, and chickens—as in fact a 1990 family planning initiative proposed. But this depends on one’s point of view. Such a proposal would probably have seemed reasonable to an upper-class or middle-class family in Cairo, and indeed the birth rate among such families was already much lower. But to a rural family or among the urban poor it might seem far less reasonable.
zh: 有人可能会说，每年2.5%以上的人口增长率仍然非常高。少生些孩子，多养些水牛、奶牛和鸡，当然会更好——事实上1990年一项计划生育倡议正是这样提议的。但这取决于看问题的角度。这样的提议对一个开罗的上层或中产家庭来说可能显得合理，而且这类家庭的出生率确实已经低得多。但对一个农村家庭或城市贫民来说，这或许显得远不那么合理。

en: In a social world where daughters leave their parents’ family at marriage to join their husbands’ households, and where there is virtually no system of social security to support parents when they become too old or sick to work, it can be argued that to desire a minimum of two surviving male children was not excessive. According to figures for 1980, in rural Upper Egypt, the poorest part of the country and the region with the highest fertility rate, women gave birth to an average of 7.5 children during their childbearing years. But almost one in three of their children (2.7 out of the 7.5) died in childhood.

Under these circumstances, if the parents’ aim was to ensure that at least two sons survived to support them in later life, then 7.5 children was not an unreasonable birth rate. After 1980 infant deaths were reduced, thanks largely to a simple treatment for diarrhea, and women began to have smaller families.
zh: 在一个女儿婚后离开父母家庭、加入丈夫家户的社会世界里，在一个几乎没有任何社会保障制度能在父母年老或病重无法工作时供养他们的社会里，可以论证，希望至少有两个存活的儿子并不算过分。根据1980年的数字，在上埃及农村——全国最贫困的地区，也是生育率最高的地区——妇女在育龄期间平均生育7.5个孩子。但她们的孩子中几乎每三个就有一个（7.5个中的2.7个）在童年死亡。
在这种情况下，如果父母的目标是确保至少两个儿子活下来，在晚年供养他们，那么7.5个孩子并非不合理的生育率。1980年后，婴儿死亡率下降——主要归功于一种简单的腹泻疗法——妇女们开始拥有更小的家庭。

en: These women were unlikely to attribute their economic problems to population growth, as did the World Bank. Far more serious, perhaps, was the insecurity of their futures, their meager share of local, national, and global resources, and the political and economic powerlessness that prevented them from altering this condition. Any discussion of their situation would have to start from this question of power.
zh: 这些妇女不太可能像世界银行那样，把自己的经济问题归咎于人口增长。或许远为严重的是她们未来的不安全，她们在地方、全国和全球资源中微薄的份额，以及使她们无法改变这种状况的政治和经济上的无力。任何关于她们处境的讨论都必须从权力问题开始。

en: not enough land?
zh: 土地不够？

en: The effect the pictorial framework has on the analysis it introduces can be seen by turning to the question that is central to the problem of rural poverty and powerlessness, that of land distribution. The image of a narrow strip of fertile land crammed with so many millions of inhabitants enabled most contemporary analyses of Egyptian economic development to move very quickly past the problem of access to land. With so many people occupying so little space, the problem appeared to be already explained. “The present picture is not bright,” concluded a study for USAID in 1976 discussing the economic status of the farmer, “mainly because there is just not enough land to go around. The average size of a holding is two feddans [acres], 94 percent of all owners have less than 5 feddans each, and only 0.2 percent have at least 50 feddans each.”
zh: 这种图像式框架对其所引出的分析的影响，可以通过转向土地分配问题——农村贫困和无权问题的核心——来看出。一条狭长肥沃土地上挤满数千万居民的意象，使大多数当代埃及经济发展分析得以很快略过获得土地的问题。这么多人占据如此小的空间，问题似乎已经得到解释。“目前的景象并不光明，”1976年一份为美国国际开发署撰写、讨论农民经济状况的研究总结道，“主要因为可供分配的土地就是不够。每份地产平均为两费丹〔原文括注 acres，指埃及费丹〕，94%的所有者每人不到5费丹，只有0.2%每人拥有至少50费丹。”

en: This picture of a countryside made up of millions of tiny parcels of land suggested once again that if Egyptian farmers were finding things difficult, it was because there were just too many of them for the space available. As before, however, we should ignore the image and check the figures.
zh: 这幅由数百万块微小土地组成的乡村图景再次暗示，如果埃及农民觉得日子难过，那是因为相对于可用空间，他们的人数太多。然而，一如从前，我们应当忽略图像，核对数字。

en: First of all, holdings of less than five acres are not as small as they may seem. With Egypt’s fertile soils, year-round sunshine, and permanently available irrigation water, the country is like an open-air greenhouse in which high yields can be obtained from two or even three crops a year. A five-acre holding produces between ten and fifteen acres of crops a year. In fact five acres is reckoned to be the maximum size for a family farm—the maximum area a family of five can cultivate on its own, working full time, without hired labor.

The minimum farm size required for such a family to feed itself, assuming an annual consumption of 250 kilograms of grains (or equivalent) per head and a state tax of 30 percent of production, was estimated in 1982 to be 0.8 feddan (acre), or just over 19 qirats (1 feddan = 24 qirats).
Given the increase in yields in the 1980s, the minimum area required by 1988 was only 0.625 feddan, or 15 qirats.
zh: 首先，不到五费丹的地产并不像看上去那么小。凭借埃及肥沃的土壤、全年充足的阳光和常年可用的灌溉水，这个国家就像一座露天温室，一年可种两茬甚至三茬作物，从而获得高产。一块五费丹的地产每年产出相当于十到十五费丹的作物。事实上，五费丹被认为是家庭农场的最大规模——一个五口之家在没有雇工的情况下全职耕作所能经营的最大面积。
假设每人每年消费250公斤谷物（或当量）、国家按产量的30%征税，这样一个家庭养活自己所需的最小农场规模，1982年估计为0.8费丹（原文括注 acre），即略多于19基拉特（1费丹=24基拉特）。
考虑到1980年代产量的提高，到1988年所需的最小面积为仅0.625费丹，即15基拉特。

en: The USAID report mentioned that 94 percent of landholdings were smaller than five acres, the limit of a family farm. What it failed to mention was that the remaining 6 percent of landholders, with holdings from five acres up to the legal limit of fifty acres per individual or one hundred acres per family with dependent children, controlled 33 percent of the country’s agricultural area.
From the mid-1970s, moreover, these large landholdings increased in number. By 1982 they represented 10 percent of holdings and controlled 47.5 percent of the country’s cultivated area.
zh: 美国国际开发署的报告提到，94%的地产小于五费丹这一家庭农场的上限。它没有提到的是，其余6%的土地所有者——其地产从五费丹到每人五十费丹或每个有受抚养子女的家庭一百费丹的法定上限——控制着全国33%的农业面积。
此外，从1970年代中期起，这些大地产的数量增加了。到1982年，它们占地产的10%，控制着全国耕地面积的47.5%。

en: The official figures, furthermore, underrepresented the concentration of landholding, for they were based on village land registers. Studies of landholding in individual villages frequently revealed a much greater concentration of ownership, as I discussed in chapter 5, with the largest farms being registered under several different names to stay within the legal limit. The official limits also did not apply to the large holdings of agribusiness corporations. In the 1980s, for example, Bechtel International Agribusiness Division managed a ten-thousand-acre estate in Nubariyya owned by a Gulf investor,

and the Delta Sugar Company, a joint venture of the Egyptian state sugar company and a group of Egyptian and international banks, owned a forty-thousand-acre estate on irrigated land in the north-central Delta.
zh: 此外，官方数字低估了土地占有的集中程度，因为它们依据的是村庄土地登记册。对个别村庄土地占有的研究常常揭示出高得多的所有权集中，正如我在第5章所讨论的，最大的农场登记在几个不同的名下，以保持在法定上限之内。官方法定上限也不适用于农业综合企业的大地产。例如1980年代，柏克德国际农业综合企业部管理着努巴里亚一座属于一位海湾投资者的一万费丹庄园，
而三角洲糖业公司——埃及国有糖业公司与一批埃及和国际银行的合资企业——在三角洲中北部灌溉地上拥有一座四万费丹的庄园。

en: Even if one ignores these additional forms of landholding, the official figures still represented a large concentration of land in relatively few hands. The limit of fifty to one hundred acres should be compared with the limit of about 2.5 to seven acres (one to three hectares) achieved in the 1940s and 1950s by the land reform programs of Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea.

In Korea, less than 20 percent of the land in 1975 was held in farms of two hectares or more (approximately five acres), while in Egypt almost half the land (47.5 percent) was in holdings above this limit.
On the other hand, almost one-third of landholders in Egypt (32.3 percent) had holdings under one acre, amounting to only 6 percent of the agricultural area.
In addition, a significant but unmeasured proportion of the agricultural workforce, which totaled 4.3 million workers in 1985,
remained without any land at all.
zh: 即使忽略这些额外的地产形式，官方数字仍然表明土地大量集中在相对少数人手中。应当把五十至一百费丹的上限与1940年代和1950年代日本、台湾和韩国土地改革计划所实现的约2.5至7费丹（1至3公顷）的上限相比较。
在韩国，1975年不到20%的土地属于两公顷（约五费丹）及以上的农场，而在埃及，几乎一半的土地（47.5%）是超过这一上限的地产。
另一方面，埃及近三分之一（32.3%）的土地所有者拥有不到一费丹的地产，仅占农业面积的6%。
此外，1985年总计430万人的农业劳动力中，有相当大但未测算比例的人完全没有任何土地。

en: If Egypt were to carry out land reform measures comparable to those of Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan, the problem of landlessness and near landlessness would be eliminated.
By placing the ceiling on landholding at three acres (an area several times the minimum required to feed a family), at least 2.6 million acres of land would be available for redistribution.

If distributed to the landless and near landless, no agricultural household in Egypt would have less than the fifteen qirats required to feed itself. Total agricultural production would also be likely to increase, as there is ample evidence that small farmers produce larger yields per acre than large farmers.

East Asia also provided a model for financing such a redistribution. In the Taiwanese land reform of 1953, the government compensated large owners through a concurrent privatization program, giving them shares in the Taiwan Cement Corporation and other state-owned industries inherited from the Japanese occupation.

In the 1990s Egypt launched a program to privatize state-owned enterprises, including several cement companies. The distribution of shares in this property offered a straightforward method of paying compensation for the redistribution of land in the countryside.
zh: 如果埃及实行可与日本、韩国和台湾相比较的土地改革措施，无地或少地问题就会被消除。
若把土地占有上限设为三费丹（是养活一个家庭所需最低面积的数倍），至少有260万费丹土地可供重新分配。
如果分配给无地者和少地者，埃及就不会有任何农业家户的土地少于养活自己所需的15基拉特。农业生产总量也可能增加，因为有充分证据表明小农每费丹产量高于大农。
东亚还提供了为这种再分配融资的模式。在1953年台湾土地改革中，政府通过同时进行的私有化计划补偿大地主，给予他们台湾水泥公司和其他继承自日本占领时期的国有工业企业的股份。
1990年代，埃及启动了一项国有企业私有化计划，包括几家水泥公司。分配这些财产中的股份，为补偿农村土地再分配提供了一种直截了当的方法。

en: The discussion of landholding in Egypt usually ignores the large proportion of land held in amounts over five acres, and refers to such holdings as merely “medium” sized. Only owners of more than fifty acres are labeled “large.” The fifty-acre threshold, incorporated into the 1961 land reform law, was the definition of large landowner formulated in 1894 by the British consul-general in Egypt, Lord Cromer, in accordance with British political and fiscal interests.

It takes no account of the contemporary interests of most Egyptian farmers. Nor does its continued use reflect the fact that crop yields increased by a factor of 4.5 over the one hundred years after the British occupation.

A 50-acre farm in 1982 produced as much as a 225-acre farm of the 1880s, or perhaps a 450-acre farm if one took into account the spread of perennial irrigation and double and triple cropping. From 1982 to 1999, moreover, yields of wheat, the major food crop, grew by another 80 percent, further increasing the output of large farms.
zh: 关于埃及土地占有的讨论通常忽略五费丹以上土地占有形式所占的大比例，并把这类地产仅称为“中等”规模。只有五十费丹以上的所有者才被标为“大”。这一五十费丹的门槛被纳入1961年土地改革法，是英国驻埃及总领事克罗默勋爵1894年根据英国政治和财政利益所制定的大地主定义。
它没有考虑大多数埃及农民当代的利益。它的继续使用也没有反映这样一个事实：在英国占领之后的百年间，作物产量增长了4.5倍。
1982年一个50费丹的农场产量相当于1880年代一个225费丹的农场，如果考虑到常年灌溉和双季、三季种植的推广，或许相当于一个450费丹的农场。此外，从1982年到1999年，主要粮食作物小麦的产量又增长了80%，进一步提高了大农场的产出。

en: The redistribution of agricultural land also offered a way to create nonagricultural livelihoods in the countryside and provincial towns. Increasing the number and assets of small farming households would generate three kinds of local economic linkage.

It would increase demand, first, for locally made agricultural inputs (ploughs, hand tools, draft animals, carts, threshing machines, and small irrigation pumps); second, for consumer goods made and serviced by local industry (furniture, building materials, basic appliances and electronics) rather than luxuries imported from abroad; and third, for a variety of local processing industries for food and textile crops, such as small wheat and rice mills, sugarcane processing, and textile looms. Compared to the large-scale, capital-intensive industry favored by the state and international financial institutions, small-scale processing industries based on intermediate technology had two advantages. They typically produced a less refined and more nutritious product, such as brown sugar or whole-grain flour. And they employed more people and produced goods at lower overall cost.
zh: 农业用地的再分配还为在农村和省级城镇创造非农业生计提供了一条途径。增加小农户的数量和资产，会产生三种地方经济联系。

首先，它将增加对本地制造的农业投入品（犁、手工工具、役畜、大车、脱粒机和小型灌溉泵）的需求；其次，增加对由地方工业制造和维修的消费品（家具、建筑材料、基本电器和电子产品）而非从国外进口的奢侈品的需求；第三，增加对各种本地食品和纺织作物加工产业的需求，如小型面粉厂和碾米厂、甘蔗加工和纺织织机。与国家及国际金融机构青睐的大规模、资本密集型产业相比，以中间技术为基础的小规模加工业有两个优势。它们通常生产不那么精细、更有营养的产品，如红糖或全麦面粉。而且它们雇用更多人，并以更低的总体成本生产商品。

en: The redistribution of agricultural land offered a workable and proven means of creating sustainable rural livelihoods.

Over the following decade, in other parts of the world land reform was “back on the agenda,” the U. N. Food and Agriculture Organization reported, mainly because rural populations put it there. The Chiapas rebellion in Mexico, the invasions of land seekers in Malawi and Zimbabwe, the Movimento Sem Terra in Brazil, the demand for restitution of property taken by the apartheid regime in South Africa, and the success of the 1990s land reform in the Philippines, all contributed to this new pressure to recognize the importance of land rights for small farmers.

But in official studies of the obstacles to Egypt’s further economic development, the question of additional land reform was simply never raised. USAID refused to support detailed independent proposals for land reform and instead, as we will see, helped to introduce a “free market” program for rural Egypt that began to undo earlier reforms and consolidate land into larger farms.

Thanks to the powerful image of millions of Egyptian peasants squeezed into a narrow river valley, it seemed natural to assume that landholdings were already smaller than was practicable and that other sorts of solutions were required.
zh: 农业用地的再分配为创造可持续的农村生计提供了一种可行且已被证明的办法。
联合国粮食及农业组织报告说，在接下来的十年里，在世界其他地区，土地改革“重新回到议程上”，主要是因为农村人口把它放回了议程。墨西哥恰帕斯叛乱、马拉维和津巴布韦的争地者入侵、巴西的无地农民运动、南非要求归还种族隔离政权夺走的财产，以及菲律宾1990年代土地改革的成功，都促成了这种承认小农土地权利之重要性的新压力。
但在关于埃及进一步经济发展障碍的官方研究中，进一步的土改问题根本没有被提出。美国国际开发署拒绝支持独立的详细土改建议，反而如我们将看到的，帮助为埃及农村引入了一项“自由市场”计划，该计划开始瓦解早先的改革，并把土地合并为大农场。
由于数千万埃及农民挤在狭窄河谷中的有力意象，人们很自然地以为，土地占有已经小于可行规模，需要的是其他种类的解决办法。

en: high-payoff inputs
zh: 高回报投入

en: Once the problems Egypt faces were defined as natural rather than political, questions of social inequality and powerlessness disappeared into the background. The analysis could then focus instead on how to overcome these “natural” limits of geography and demography. In the 1980s the international development industry in Egypt proposed and funded two complementary methods for the solution of Egypt’s problems, the technological and the managerial. One required large capital resources from the West, the other its expertise.“The development problem is essentially a question of the quantity, quality and proportion of resources to be devoted to development on the one hand,” according to a World Bank report on Egypt that laid out an agenda for the 1980s and 1990s, “and to economic management on the other.”

The productive limits set by nature, in other words, would be overcome by the forces of technology, while existing natural resources would be made more productive by more rational and efficient management—in particular by dismantling the bureaucracy of the Egyptian state and recasting its power in the form of “market forces.”
zh: 一旦埃及面临的问题被界定为自然问题而非政治问题，社会不平等和无权问题就退到了背景之中。分析于是可以转而关注如何克服这些地理和人口的“自然”限制。1980年代，国际发展产业在埃及提出并资助了两种互补的方法来解决埃及的问题：技术性的和管理性的。一种需要来自西方的大量资本资源，另一种需要它的专业知识。据世界银行一份为1980年代和1990年代制定议程的埃及报告，“发展问题本质上是一方面有多少数量、质量和比例的资源用于发展……另一方面用于经济管理的问题。”
换言之，自然设定的生产限制将由技术力量克服，而现有自然资源将通过更合理有效的管理——特别是通过拆解埃及国家的官僚机构、以“市场力量”的形式重塑其权力——变得更有生产力。

en: The timeless image of the Nile River and its inhabitants often introduces a certain construction of history, from which follows the need for technological rather than political solutions. The geographical determinism of the image implies an agricultural order that remains in essential ways unchanged since antiquity. Only recently, it seems, has this ancient world discovered the West—or its synonym,“the twentieth century.”This relationship between nature and an unchanging history was expressed in one of the passages already quoted from a USAID report:“One of the world’s oldest agricultural economies, Egypt depends upon the fruits of the narrow ribbon of cultivated land adjacent to the Nile and to that river’s rich fanshaped delta. For more than 5,000 years agriculture has sustained Egypt.”

A similar theme, and similar words, are found introducing an earlier report for USAID. “The Nile Delta and its lifeline, the Nile River Valley extending southward some 600 miles, is one of the oldest agricultural areas of the world, having been under continuous cultivation for at least 5,000 years.” With this in mind we are ready to accept a few lines further down the strange idea that, “In many respects, Egypt entered the twentieth century after the 1952 Revolution.”
A 1977 USAID report stated baldly that “The transformation of the Egyptian village started twenty five years ago with the agrarian reform measures.”

In the same years, as we saw in chapter 4, Richard Critchfield was writing the same thing in his Ford Foundation– funded study, Shahhat, after which he was hired by USAID as an expert on rural development.
zh: 尼罗河及其居民那超越时间的意象，常常引出一种特定的历史建构，由此产生的是对技术而非政治解决办法的需要。这一意象的地理决定论暗示着一种自古代以来在本质方面并未改变的农业秩序。看来这个古老世界直到晚近才发现西方——或它的同义词“20世纪”。自然与不变历史之间的这种关系，在已经引用过的一段美国国际开发署报告中得到了表达：“埃及是世界上最古老的农业经济体之一，依赖毗邻尼罗河的那条狭长耕地带以及该河扇形沃饶的三角洲的果实。五千多年来，农业支撑着埃及。”
在为美国国际开发署撰写的一份更早报告中，也能找到类似的题目和类似的措辞。“尼罗河三角洲及其生命线——向南延伸约600英里的尼罗河谷——是世界上最古老的农业地区之一，至少连续耕作已五千年。”有鉴于此，我们便准备好接受几行之后那个奇怪的说法：“在许多方面，埃及是在1952年革命之后才进入20世纪的。”
美国国际开发署1977年的一份报告直截了当地说：“埃及村庄的改造始于二十五年前的农业改革措施。”
同一时期，正如我们在第4章所见，理查德·克里奇菲尔德在其由福特基金会资助的研究《沙哈特》中写下了同样的东西，此后他被美国国际开发署聘为农村发展专家。

en: The implication of these statements and images—that until the latter half of the twentieth century life in the Nile valley had remained essentially unchanged for centuries, if not millennia—is of course highly misleading. As earlier chapters have stressed, it ignores hundreds of years of far-reaching economic and political changes, such as the growth in the Middle Ages and subsequent decline of a network of world trade passing through the Nile valley, or the consolidation in the nineteenth century of a system of export-oriented agricultural production based on irrigation works and private landownership, all of which involved transformations in Egyptian villages as important as the land reforms and irrigation schemes of the mid-twentieth century. Ignoring such developments creates the reassuring impression that the poverty of the Nile valley is the traditional poverty of a peasantry that has not yet or has only recently joined the “twentieth century,” rather than very much a product of the political and economic forces of that century.
zh: 这些说法和意象的含意——即直到20世纪下半叶，尼罗河谷的生活在数世纪乃至数千年间基本未变——当然是高度误导性的。正如前面几章所强调的，它忽略了数百年深远的政治经济变迁，例如中世纪途经尼罗河谷的世界贸易网络的兴起及随后的衰落，或19世纪一个以灌溉工程和私有土地所有权为基础的出口导向农业生产体系的巩固；所有这些都涉及埃及村庄中与20世纪中叶的土地改革和灌溉计划同样重要的转变。忽视这些发展造成一种令人安心的印象：尼罗河谷的贫困是一个尚未或直到晚近才加入“20世纪”的农民阶级的传统贫困，而不是那个世纪政治经济力量的产物。

en: This image of a traditional rural world implies a static agricultural system that cannot change itself. If Egypt “is to fully enter the modern world,” a report for USAID in 1976 explained, the impetus and the means must come from outside.
These external forces must carry out not simply adjustments to the existing system but what the World Bank in 1980 called a “qualitative transformation” of Egyptian agriculture.

New capital investment, new irrigation methods, improved seed varieties, mechanization, and the switch to export crops such as vegetables and cut flowers to bring in the foreign capital required to finance such technologies were the principal means to achieve this transformation.
zh: 这种传统乡村世界的意象暗示着一个无法自我改变的静止农业体系。1976年一份为美国国际开发署撰写的报告解释说，如果埃及“要完全进入现代世界”，动力和手段必须来自外部。
这些外部力量不仅要调整现有体系，还要完成世界银行1980年所称的埃及农业的“质变”。
新的资本投资、新的灌溉方法、改良种子品种、机械化，以及转向蔬菜和切花等出口作物以赚取为这类技术融资所需的外汇，是实现这一转变的主要手段。

en: USAID’s Agricultural Mechanization Project, which ran from 1979 to 1987, used just this image of a “traditional” agricultural system to justify technological solutions to the problems of rural Egypt. The project’s aim was to encourage the mechanization of Egyptian farming by purchasing agricultural machinery from the United States for field trials and demonstration programs in Egypt, financing the construction of service centers for the machinery, and sending Egyptians to the United States and other countries for training in “the techniques of technology transfer.”

USAID awarded the $38 million contract for this to Louis Berger International of East Orange, New Jersey. In their final report, the contractors explained the “underlying philosophy” of the mechanization program. “To ensure that the project serves the purposes of development, it is necessary to relate mechanization to development theory so that mechanization does not conflict with, but rather is supportive of, development objectives.”
zh: 美国国际开发署1979年至1987年实施的农业机械化项目，正是利用这种“传统”农业体系的意象，为埃及农村问题的技术解决办法辩护。该项目旨在通过从美国购买农业机械、在埃及进行田间试验和示范项目、资助建设机械服务中心，并送埃及人到美国和其他国家接受“技术转移技巧”培训，来鼓励埃及农业机械化。
美国国际开发署把这份3,800万美元的合同授予了新泽西州东奥兰治的路易斯·伯格国际公司。承包商在最终报告中解释了机械化项目的“基本理念”。“为确保项目服务于发展目的，必须把机械化与发展理论联系起来，使机械化不与发展目标冲突，而是支持发展目标。”

en: To supply the kind of theory that would ensure “the purposes of development” were served, they drew on the ideas of Theodore Schultz, whose Transforming Traditional Agriculture (1964) was an early classic in the field of economic development. Schultz argued that farmers in “traditional” agriculture make efficient use of their resources within the limits of the expertise and technology available to them. Through long years of trial and error, he claimed, they have eliminated inefficiencies and wastage and reached “a particular type of equilibrium” in which the agricultural economy is “incapable of growth except at high cost.” Only the large-scale introduction of new technology and capital from outside this equilibrium can enable the farmer “to transform the traditional agriculture of his forebears.”

“In other words,” Louis Berger International explained, “the continued investment in traditional inputs will produce very little in terms of an additional income stream. Consequently, the transformation from traditional agriculture is an investment problem dependent on a flow of new high-payoff inputs: the inputs of scientific agriculture.”

There has probably never been a “traditional” agriculture resembling Schultz’s description. Certainly no such system has existed in Egypt in recent historical memory, still less in the 1980s when Louis Berger International arrived there from New Jersey. What was missing most of all from Schultz’s account of individual farmers making rational decisions to maximize their income, as an anthropologist’s critique points out, was any concept of social and economic inequality.
zh: 为了提供能够确保“发展目的”得以实现的那种理论，他们借用了西奥多·舒尔茨的思想；舒尔茨的《改造传统农业》（1964）是经济发展领域早期的经典著作。舒尔茨论证说，“传统”农业中的农民在其可获得的知识和技术限度内有效利用资源。他声称，经过多年的试错，他们已经消除了低效和浪费，达到了“一种特定类型的均衡”，其中农业经济“除非付出高昂代价便无法增长”。只有在这一均衡之外大规模引入新技术和资本，才能使农民“改造其祖先的传统农业”。
“换言之，”路易斯·伯格国际公司解释说，“继续投资于传统投入品，在增加收入流方面几乎不会产生什么效果。因此，从传统农业的转变是一个投资问题，取决于新的高回报投入品的流入：科学农业的投入品。”
可能从未存在过舒尔茨所描述的那种“传统”农业。在近代历史记忆中，埃及当然不曾存在这样的体系，更不用说1980年代路易斯·伯格国际公司从新泽西来到这里的时候。正如一位人类学家的批评所指出的，舒尔茨关于个体农民做出理性决策以最大化收入的说法，最缺少的是社会和经济不平等的概念。

en: Schultz tested his theory using evidence from studies of a Guatemalan village by Sol Tax (1953) and a village in north India by David Hopper (1957).

The Guatemalan village was involved mostly in trade rather than the production of food for local consumption, so it was hardly “typical of a large class of poor agricultural communities,” as Schultz claimed.

The Indian village yielded evidence that the proportion of land and other resources allocated to various crops corresponded closely to their relative market prices, so that altering the allocation of inputs would not significantly increase the farmers’ income.

But this analysis paid no attention to inequality and the difference that poverty makes. “Severely impoverished individuals,” Hill notes, “who exist in all communities, . . . are necessarily inefficient if only because they lack the resources to set themselves to work effectively.”

For example, poor farmers in Egypt usually cannot afford sufficient fertilizer for their crops and may get lower yields as a result. The most “efficient” allocation of resources in Schultz’s terms, Hill points out, would allocate no land at all to the poorest farmers.
zh: 舒尔茨用索尔·塔克斯（1953）对危地马拉一个村庄的研究和大卫·霍珀（1957）对印度北部一个村庄的研究作为证据，检验了他的理论。
危地马拉那个村庄主要从事贸易，而不是生产供当地消费的粮食，因此很难说它“代表一大类贫困农业共同体”，如舒尔茨所声称的那样。
印度村庄的证据表明，分配给各种作物的土地和其他资源比例与其相对市场价格密切相关，因此改变投入品分配不会显著增加农民的收入。
但这种分析没有关注不平等以及贫困所造成的差异。“严重贫困的个人，”希尔指出，“存在于所有共同体中……必然效率低下，哪怕仅仅因为他们缺乏资源来有效地投入工作。”
例如，埃及的贫困农民通常买不起足够的肥料用于作物，结果产量可能较低。希尔指出，用舒尔茨的话说，最“有效”的资源分配将完全不给最贫困的农民分配土地。

en: Despite the lack of firm evidence for Schultz’s rather dated argument, it supplied the “philosophy” to justify American funding for the mechanization of Egyptian agriculture. Mechanization was also funded by the World Bank and by the Japanese Agency for International Cooperation.

These external funds required large additional contributions from the Egyptian government, which was already paying for mechanization by providing farmers with subsidized loans and fuel. Consultants hired by USAID claimed that this “high-payoff” solution to Egypt’s problems would shorten the interval between crops and increase crop yields by as much as 55 percent.

This claim contradicted the evidence from other countries, which suggested that higher crop yields occur with mechanization only in exceptional cases, and certainly not under conditions of intensive land use as in Egypt.
It also contradicted existing experience in Egypt, where, as Alan Richards reported, there was “no evidence that tractor farms have higher yields or cropping intensities than unmechanized farms.”
A subsequent study showed that indeed no increase in yields had occurred.
zh: 尽管舒尔茨相当过时的论点缺乏确凿证据，它还是提供了“哲学”，为美国资助埃及农业机械化提供了理由。机械化也得到了世界银行和日本国际协力机构的资助。
这些外部资金需要埃及政府提供大量额外配套资金，而埃及政府已经通过向农民提供补贴贷款和燃料来支付机械化费用。美国国际开发署聘用的咨询顾问声称，这一解决埃及问题的“高回报”办法将缩短作物间隔，并使作物产量提高多达55%。
这一说法与其他国家的证据相矛盾。那些证据表明，机械化只有在特殊情况下才会带来更高的作物产量，在埃及那样的集约用地条件下肯定不会。
它也与埃及的既有经验相矛盾：正如艾伦·理查兹所报告的，“没有证据表明有拖拉机的农场比未机械化的农场产量更高或复种指数更高。”
随后的一项研究表明，产量确实没有增加。

en: The demand for mechanization had intensified among large landowners in the later 1970s, due to a supposed shortage of agricultural labor that lasted into the early 1980s. This “shortage” took the form of a temporary rise in the wages of male agricultural laborers, particularly in regions close to large cities, caused by the higher wages available for urban construction work during the building boom of that period and by labor migration to the oil-rich countries of the Gulf.

Agricultural wages, having averaged only one-third of the average real wage for all economic sectors during the first half of the 1970s, for a while began to catch up with urban wages. Large farmers, given the artificially low prices they received for their crops, were unable or unwilling to pay the higher wages. The larger cause of the labor “shortage,” in other words, was the unequal distribution of land into large farms requiring hired labor (small farms use mostly family or cooperative labor) and the low agricultural prices imposed by the state. Rather than addressing these problems, however, the government, large farmers, and international development agencies turned to the high-payoff program of mechanization. The high payoffs did not take the form of increased yields, as we have seen, but of higher profits to the new machine owners and their importing agents and foreign manufacturers. The demand for rural male labor was reduced once again, and the inequalities between agricultural laborers and landowners were kept in place. It is these inequalities that mechanization and other “high-payoff” inputs consolidate, and that accounts of the Nile valley and the need to transform its “traditional” agriculture keep from view.
zh: 1970年代后期，由于所谓的农业劳动力短缺（一直持续到1980年代初），大地主对机械化的需求加剧了。这种“短缺”表现为男性农业雇工工资的暂时上涨，尤其是在靠近大城市的地区；原因是那个时期的建筑热潮中城市建筑工作提供了更高工资，以及劳动力向海湾产油国的迁移。

在1970年代前半期，农业工资平均仅为所有经济部门平均实际工资的三分之一，此时一度开始赶上城市工资。大地主由于农产品价格被人为压低，无法或不愿支付更高的工资。换句话说，“短缺”的更主要原因是土地不平等地集中到需要雇工的大农场（小农场主要使用家庭或合作劳动），以及国家强加的低农产品价格。然而，政府、大地主和国际发展机构没有着手解决这些问题，而是转向高回报的机械化计划。高回报并不表现为产量的增加，如我们所见，而是表现为新机器所有者及其进口代理商和外国制造商更高的利润。农村男性劳动力的需求再次减少，农业雇工与土地所有者之间的不平等得以维持。机械化和其他“高回报”投入所巩固的正是这些不平等，而关于尼罗河谷及其“传统”农业需要改造的叙述则使这些不平等始终不被看见。

en: decentralization and the market
zh: 去中心化与市场

en: There is a second dimension to rural inequality in Egypt, and a second aspect to the historical image of the Nile valley that tends to naturalize it. The rural poor suffered not only from local inequalities in distribution of land and other resources, but also from the inequality of central government policies that transferred wealth from the rural population to the state. The state had come to play a major role not just in maintaining inequality, but in producing it. This is a political question, requiring an analysis of the networks of power and privilege that pass through the state and tap into the wealth it appropriates. International development, with its naturalized images of the Nile valley and its limited resources, depoliticizes this issue and transforms it into a question of the proper management of resources. The solutions that follow are those that are supposed to increase efficiency: decentralizing the state and reconfiguring some of its networks and powers as forces of “the market.”
zh: 埃及农村不平等还有第二个维度，而尼罗河谷的历史意象还有第二个方面倾向于把它自然化。农村穷人不仅受困于地方的土地和其他资源分配不平等，还受困于中央政府政策的不平等——这些政策把财富从农村人口转移到国家。国家不仅维持不平等，而且越来越在生产不平等方面发挥主要作用。这是一个政治问题，需要分析贯穿国家、并汲取其所占财富的权力与特权网络。国际发展以其自然化的尼罗河谷及其有限资源意象，使这个问题去政治化，把它转化为资源适当管理的问题。随之而来的解决办法据称是提高效率的办法：使国家去中心化，并把其部分网络和权力重新配置为“市场”力量。

en: Before 1952 it was mostly the institution of large landowning that extracted wealth from the farming population and transferred it elsewhere. The 1952 land reforms preserved significant landholding inequalities, but placed a majority of farmers directly under the control of the central government and its compulsory cropping requirements, requisitions, and price policies. Even if one takes into account state investment in irrigation and the subsidizing of farm inputs, the net effect of government policies between 1960 and 1985 was estimated to appropriate 35 percent of agricultural GDP.

Small farmers, moreover, suffered more than larger landowners, as the latter had greater opportunity to invest in more profitable areas such as fruit, vegetable, and dairy farming. After 1974 the government began to relax the compulsory cropping and price fixing policies, and after 1986 to abolish them. But the changes were carried out in a way that benefited primarily larger landowners. Smallholders continued to be disproportionately involved in cotton, rice, and sugarcane production, where fixed prices and compulsory deliveries to the state were the last to be relaxed. To complete the reversal of the 1952 reforms, in 1992 the government moved to abolish the security of tenant farmers, reestablishing the “free market” in agricultural land and causing hundreds of thousands of small farmers to be faced with the risk of eviction (see chapter 8).
zh: 1952年以前，主要是大土地所有权制度从农业人口中抽取财富并转移到别处。1952年的土地改革保留了显著的土地占有不平等，却把大多数农民直接置于中央政府的控制之下，受其强制种植要求、征购和价格政策支配。即使把国家对灌溉的投资和对农业投入品的补贴考虑在内，1960年至1985年间政府政策的净效应据估计仍占用了农业国内生产总值的35%。

此外，小农比大地主受害更深，因为后者更有机会投资于水果、蔬菜和乳业等更有利可图的领域。1974年后，政府开始放宽强制种植和价格固定政策，1986年后予以废除。但变革的推行方式主要有利于大地主。小农仍然不成比例地从事棉花、水稻和甘蔗生产，而这些作物的固定价格和向国家强制交售是最后才放宽的。为完成对1952年改革的逆转，政府于1992年着手废除佃农的保障，重建农业用地的“自由市场”，使数十万小农面临被驱逐的风险（见第8章）。

en: The system for appropriating wealth from the countryside needs to be examined as a political process, in which changing state policies have reflected a complex of dominant (although not always coherent) social interests—those of the state managers and bureaucrats, the growing government-supported private sector, and larger rural landowners. The image of the Nile valley, its population, and a five-thousand-year-old agriculture makes it possible to ascribe this appropriation instead to a “tradition” of “strong central government” determined by the very geography of the Nile valley and stretching back to Pharaonic times. Thus the coordinator of a USAID-funded program at Eastern Kentucky University providing management training to Egyptian local government officials explained, “For centuries Egypt has been governed as a political system with a highly centralized decision making process. Although there have been a few minor exceptions, this statement is valid for the period since the unification of Upper and Lower Egypt was accomplished late in the fourth millennium B.C.—i.e. for at least the past 5 thousand years.”

Drawing on familiar imagery, the author went on to explain this centralized power in geographical and demographic terms. “Integral to the question of administrative structure of the Arab Republic of Egypt is its principal social and economic problem—over-population—and the Nile River. Although the land mass area of the ARE includes 386,000 square miles, over 96 percent of the population resides on the 4 percent of the land area adjacent to the Nile valley and its delta.”

Depoliticized in this way, the state’s role in agriculture ceased to be a question of power and control over people’s resources and lives. It became instead a problem of management. The intervention of the state has resulted in “disequilibrium,” it was said.

The language of neoRicardian economics was employed to imagine a naturally achieved balance between forces of agricultural supply and demand, a balance called “the market.” The market is a simple image for picturing the relations between farmers, laborers, landowners, state officials, international agribusinesses, and consumers, an image that reduces these interrelated but very unequal concentrations of power into nominally equivalent buyers and sellers, and represents the inequality between them as the market’s equilibrium. Building this imagined equilibrium, which has never existed in two centuries of modern Egyptian agriculture except as a sequence of dispossessions, food shortages, monopolies, minor revolts, violent repressions, and urgent demands for state intervention, was the aim of the process of “structural adjustment.”
zh: 这种从乡村抽取财富的制度需要作为一个政治过程来考察，其中变化的国家政策反映了一系列主导性（尽管并不总是连贯）的社会利益——国家管理者和官僚、日益壮大的政府扶植的私营部门，以及较大的农村土地所有者的利益。尼罗河谷、其人口和五千年农业的意象，使人们可以把这种抽取转而归因于一种由尼罗河谷地理本身决定、可追溯至法老时代的“强中央集权政府”的“传统”。因此，东肯塔基大学一个由美国国际开发署资助、为埃及地方政府官员提供管理培训的项目协调人解释说：“数个世纪以来，埃及一直作为一个决策过程高度集权的政治体系来治理。尽管有少数次要的例外，这一说法自公元前第四千纪晚期上下埃及统一以来一直成立——也就是说，至少在过去五千年间成立。”
这位作者借助熟悉的意象，接着从地理和人口角度解释这种集权权力。“与阿拉伯埃及共和国行政结构问题密不可分的是其主要社会和经济问题——人口过剩——以及尼罗河。尽管阿拉伯埃及共和国的陆地面积为386,000平方英里，超过96%的人口居住在毗邻尼罗河谷及其三角洲的4%土地上。”
国家在农业中的作用就这样被去政治化，不再是权力和对人民资源与生活的控制问题，而成为一个管理问题。据说国家干预造成了“失衡”。

人们使用新李嘉图经济学的语言，想象农业供给与需求力量之间自然达到的平衡，这种平衡被称为“市场”。市场是一个简单的意象，用来描绘农民、雇工、土地所有者、国家官员、国际农业综合企业和消费者之间的关系；这个意象把这些相互关联但极不平等的权力集中简化为名义上平等的买方和卖方，并把它们之间的不平等表现为市场的均衡。建立这种想象出来的均衡——在现代埃及农业的两个世纪里，它从未存在过，只以一系列剥夺、粮食短缺、垄断、小规模起义、暴力镇压和迫切的政府干预要求的形式出现——就是“结构调整”过程的目标。

en: To begin creating such an equilibrium, alongside the supply of “highpayoff inputs,” USAID began to promote in rural Egypt a gradual reorganization of the role of the state, under the slogans of “decentralization” and “privatization.” USAID even talked of encouraging “democracy and pluralism” in the provinces by increasing the role of local officials and involving the country’s elected village councils.

To weaken the power of the central bureaucracy might have been a positive step for rural Egyptians, but the actual political outcome would depend on the distribution of resources and power at the provincial, district, and village levels to which authority and funds were transferred. Local government or the private sector is not necessarily more democratic, or even more efficient, than central government. Popular village councils, if they had any role at all, were frequently controlled by powerful village landowners and local officials, largely for their own benefit. Decentralization was likely to do no more than shift exploitation from one agency to another.
zh: 为了开始创造这样的均衡，美国国际开发署在提供“高回报投入品”的同时，开始在埃及农村推动国家角色的逐步重组，口号是“去中心化”和“私有化”。美国国际开发署甚至谈到，要通过增加地方官员的作用、让该国经选举产生的村议会参与进来，来在各省鼓励“民主和多元主义”。
削弱中央官僚机构的权力对埃及农民来说或许是积极的一步，但实际政治结果将取决于权力和资金所转移到的省、县和村各级的资源与权力分配。地方政府或私营部门未必比中央政府更民主，甚至未必更有效率。民众性村议会如果真有任何作用，也常常被有权势的村庄地主和地方官员控制，主要为他们自己的利益服务。去中心化很可能只不过把剥削从一个机构转移到另一个机构。

en: A review of decentralization projects in eight different villages found that funds had gone to improvements in infrastructure and to incomeproducing projects such as the purchase of milk refrigeration units; animal husbandry; poultry, bee, and silkworm raising; date packaging; olive canning; carpentry and furniture making; and the purchase of trucks, tractors, and taxis. The report, written for USAID, noted that “naturally, not all villagers have savings that enable them to invest” in these projects, and therefore the profits accrued to those in “middle to upper bracket income groups more than poor folks.”

An olive pickling and canning project in a village in Fayyum, for example, provided employment for two hundred villagers but served the marketing needs of just five wealthy farmers, for only wealthy farmers could afford to grow olive trees. Likewise, “only the wealthy villagers can hope to raise bees, because the economic success of such an enterprise requires raising at least 20 beehives, which is a large investment. Village officials such as agronomists often enter into partnership with such farmers and undertake such projects on their own.”

In other words, when they transferred resources to an existing system of inequality, decentralization and privatization were liable to reinforce that inequality. The profits went to large farmers and local state officials, and the poor received at best only certain opportunities for wage labor. The USAID report acknowledged that “the better off, the more educated and expert officials benefit more than ordinary villagers,” but argued that this was “developmentally advisable.”

“It would be remiss to call such a phenomenon exploitation simply because the better-off can benefit more,” the report argued. Exploitation in rural Egypt existed only “before 1952 where cultivators were given survival wages or shares by owners.” The relationship between rural capitalists and wage earners was termed instead “differential advantage,” meaning “the variable ability of individuals or groups to make better use and reap greater benefits than others from available opportunities.”

A sure way to “reap greater benefits” from an investment, of course, is to pay lower wages to those one employs. This “ability” was based on a distribution of land that left many villagers with no resources besides their labor, in the absence of a minimum wage, and under a system of patronage, policing, and surveillance in rural Egypt that prevented “poor folks” from protesting against or organizing to change their condition. Even when exploitation was shifted from state to local or private means and renamed “differential advantage,” it remained a politically constructed system of inequality—which decentralization and privatization programs would only reinforce.
zh: 对八个不同村庄去中心化项目的评估发现，资金流向了基础设施改善和创收项目，例如购买牛奶冷藏设备；畜牧；养禽、养蜂和养蚕；椰枣包装；橄榄罐头加工；木工和家具制造；以及购买卡车、拖拉机和出租车。为美国国际开发署撰写的这份报告指出，“自然，并非所有村民都有储蓄能够在这些项目上投资”，因此利润归于“中高收入阶层者多于穷人”。
例如，法尤姆一个村庄的橄榄腌渍和罐头项目为两百名村民提供了就业，却只满足五名富裕农民的销售需求，因为只有富裕农民才种得起橄榄树。同样，“只有富裕村民才有希望养蜂，因为这类企业的经济成功需要至少养二十个蜂箱，这是一笔大投资。农艺师之类的村庄官员常常与这类农民合伙，自己开展这类项目。”
换言之，当去中心化和私有化把资源转移到一个既有的不平等体系时，它们很可能强化这种不平等。利润流向大农场主和地方国家官员，穷人充其量只能获得某些雇工机会。美国国际开发署的报告承认，“较富裕、受教育程度较高和专业化的官员比普通村民获益更多”，但辩称这“从发展角度看是可取的”。
“仅仅因为较富裕者能获益更多就把这种现象称为剥削，那是不负责任的，”报告争辩说。农村埃及的剥削只存在于“1952年以前，当时耕作者从所有者那里获得生存工资或分成”。农村资本家与雇工之间的关系反而被称为“差别优势”，意思是“个人或群体比其他人更好地利用可获得机会并从中获取更大利益的各异能力”。
当然，要从一项投资中“获取更大利益”，一个可靠的办法就是向雇工支付更低的工资。这种“能力”的基础是土地分配使许多村民除了劳动力之外别无资源，没有最低工资，以及农村埃及一套阻止“穷人”抗议或组织起来改变自身状况的庇护、治安和监视制度。即使剥削从国家手段转移到地方或私人手段并改名为“差别优势”，它仍然是一个政治建构的不平等体系——而去中心化和私有化项目只会强化它。

en: The reinforcement of inequalities in the name of improved “management” of resources and of “removing constraints to the operation of market forces” can be seen in another major strategy for reducing the role of the state. This was what the development industry called “cost recovery” in the provision of government services.
zh: 以改善资源“管理”和“消除市场力量运作的障碍”为名强化不平等，还可以在另一项旨在减少国家作用的主要战略中看到。这就是发展产业所称的政府服务提供中的“成本回收”。

en: Cost recovery was a euphemism for transforming healthcare, schooling, and other public services into private, fee-based institutions as in the United States. In education, for example, USAID pushed for the introduction of private schooling in Egypt at the secondary and university level and, on a more modest level, for a scheme to sell advertising space on the covers of school exercise books.

In healthcare, for which USAID budgeted only $246 million from 1975 to 1989, representing 1.6 percent of total nonmilitary assistance to Egypt, the sum of $95 million (almost 40 percent of the health budget) was scheduled for privatization programs. With technical assistance from the consulting firm of Emery Associates / Taylor Associates, USAID’s aim was to “establish a sound financial structure for the health sector emphasizing cost recovery systems.” The programs involved pushing the Egyptian government to implement “policy changes to allow a fee structure for curative care” and “to convert selected hospitals and clinics to fees-for-service facilities.”

One of the advantages of selective private healthcare is its increased dependence on imported U.S. drugs and equipment. It is worth noting that even under the existing system of public financing for healthcare and schooling, Egyptians spent large personal sums on health and education. The percentage of total household consumption expenses spent on medical care in Egypt (14 percent) was already second highest in the world, after Switzerland, and equal with that of U.S., and the percentage spent on education (11 percent) was the third highest in the world, after Canada and Singapore.
zh: 成本回收是把医疗、教育和其他公共服务转变为美国那种私营收费机构的委婉说法。例如在教育领域，美国国际开发署推动在埃及中学和大学阶段引入私立教育，并在更有限的层面上推动一项在学校练习本封面上出售广告空间的计划。

在医疗领域，美国国际开发署1975年至1989年只为医疗编列了2.46亿美元预算，占对埃及非军事援助总额的1.6%，其中9,500万美元（几乎占医疗预算的40%）预定用于私有化项目。在咨询公司埃默里合伙公司/泰勒合伙公司的技术援助下，美国国际开发署的目标是“为医疗部门建立稳固的财务结构，强调成本回收制度”。这些项目推动埃及政府实施“允许治疗性护理收费结构的政策变化”和“把选定的医院和诊所转为按服务收费机构”。
选择性私营医疗的好处之一，是增加对进口美国药品和设备的依赖。值得注意的是，即使在现有的医疗和教育公共融资制度下，埃及人也在健康和教育上花费了大量个人资金。埃及家庭消费总支出中用于医疗的比例（14%）已经位居世界第二，仅次于瑞士，与美国持平；用于教育的比例（11%）位居世界第三，仅次于加拿大和新加坡。

en: Privatizing healthcare, schooling, and other social services does not inherently create a “sound financial structure.” What it does do is transfer the source of funding from government revenue, to which people contribute according to their means, to fees or insurance premiums, for which the poor must pay as much as the rich. This creates or reinforces an unequal access to healthcare and schooling. Privileged levels of education and health become, in turn, a mechanism for transferring wider social privilege from one generation to the next.
zh: 将医疗、教育和其他社会服务私有化，本身并不会创造“稳固的财务结构”。它所做的，是把资金来源从政府收入——人们按财力向其缴款——转移到收费或保险费，而穷人为此必须与富人支付同样的金额。这创造或强化了获得医疗和教育方面的不平等。享有特权的教育和健康水平又反过来成为一种机制，把更广泛的社会特权从一代传递到下一代。

en: The rhetoric of management, financial soundness, and market forces depoliticized these complex issues. Programs for decentralization and cost recovery transformed questions of social inequality and powerlessness into issues of efficiency and control—in the same way that agricultural mechanization programs transformed the question of inadequate wages and landlessness into issues of technological efficiency. The underlying political issues people faced could be ignored, because the naturalized imagery of the Nile and its population had reduced the topic to questions of natural resources and their more efficient control. It never had to be asked at whose cost efficiencies were to be made, or in whose hands control was to be strengthened.
zh: 管理、财务稳健和市场力量的修辞使这些复杂问题去政治化。去中心化和成本回收项目把社会不平等和无权问题转化为效率和控制问题——正如农业机械化项目把工资不足和无地问题转化为技术效率问题。人们面临的潜在政治问题可以被忽视，因为尼罗河及其人口的自然化意象已把话题简化为自然资源及其更有效控制的问题。人们从来不必问：效率是以谁为代价换来的，控制又将在谁的手中加强。

en: objects of development
zh: 发展的对象

en: A final aspect of the geographical image of the Nile valley was the way it removed from sight the participation of development agencies in the dynamics of Egyptian political and economic life. By portraying the country and its problems as a picture, laid out before the mind’s eye like a map, the image presented Egypt itself as something natural. The particular extent of space and population denoted by the name “Egypt” was represented as an empirical object, echoing the cadastral survey maps of the beginning of the century. Development literature reproduced the convention that Egypt exists as a sort of freestanding unit, lined up in physical space alongside a series of similar units. The workings of this unit—its economic functions, social interactions, and political processes—are understood as internal mechanisms. They constitute the unit’s inside, to be distinguished from economic and political forces that may affect it from outside.
zh: 尼罗河谷地理意象的最后一个方面，是它使发展机构在埃及政治经济生活动态中的参与脱离了视线。通过把这个国家及其问题描绘成一幅图画，像地图一样铺在心灵之眼前，这一意象把埃及本身呈现为某种自然的东西。“埃及”这个名字所指的特定空间范围和人口，被表现为一个经验对象，呼应了20世纪初的地籍测量地图。发展文献复制了这样一种惯例：埃及是一个自由独立的单位，在物理空间中与一系列类似单位并排排列。这个单位的运作——其经济功能、社会互动和政治过程——被理解为内部机制。它们构成这个单位的内部，区别于可能从外部影响它的经济和政治力量。

en: This convention of imagining countries as empirical objects is seldom recognized for what it is—a convention. The relations, forces, and movements that have shaped people’s lives over the last several hundred years have never in fact been confined within the limits of nation-states, or respected their borders. The value of what people produce, the cost of what they consume, and the purchasing power of their currency are determined by global relationships of exchange. Movements of people and cultural commodities form international flows of tourists, television programs, information, migrant workers, refugees, technologies, and fashions. The strictly “national” identity of a population, an economy, a language, or a culture is an image that has had to be continually reinvented against the force of these wider relations and movements. This has always been the case, for the global interconnection of commodities, populations, languages, and ideas is far older than the modern invention of nationstates.
zh: 这种把国家想象为经验对象的惯例，很少被认为是一种惯例。过去数百年中塑造人们生活的关系、力量和运动，事实上从未被限制在民族国家的边界之内，也从未尊重这些边界。人们所生产之物的价值、所消费之物的成本和其货币的购买力，都由全球交换关系决定。人口和文化商品的运动构成游客、电视节目、信息、移民工人、难民、技术和时尚的国际流动。一个人口、一种经济、一种语言或一种文化的严格“民族”身份，是一种必须不断针对这些更广泛关系和运动的力量重新发明的意象。情况一直如此，因为商品、人口、语言和观念在全球范围内的相互联系远比民族国家的现代发明更为古老。

en: The apparent concreteness of a modern nation-state like Egypt, its appearance as a discrete object, is the result of recent methods of organizing social practice and representing it: constructing frontiers on roads and at airports, controlling the movement of people and goods across them, producing maps and history books for schools, compiling cadastral surveys, deploying mass armies and indoctrinating those conscripted into them, representing the nation-state in news broadcasts, international sports events, and tourist literature, establishing a national currency and language, and, not least, the discourse of “country studies” and national statistics of the American-based international development industry.
zh: 埃及这样一个现代民族国家表面上的具体性，它作为一个离散对象的外观，是晚近组织社会实际并将其加以再现的方法的结果：在公路和机场设置边界，控制人和货物穿越边界，为学校制作地图和历史书，编制地籍测量，部署大规模军队并向被征召者灌输思想，在新闻广播、国际体育赛事和旅游文献中再现民族国家，建立国家货币和语言，以及——并非最不重要的——美国国际发展产业的“国别研究”话语和国家统计。

en: These essentially practical arrangements of language, imagery, space, and movement are mostly of very recent origin, as I explored in earlier chapters of this book.

We tend to think of them as processes that merely mark out and represent the nation-state, as though the nation-state itself had some prior reality. In fact the nation-state is an effect of all these everyday forms of regulation and representation, which set it up in the appearance of an empirical object. The geographical imagery of the Nile and its inhabitants that introduces so many studies of Egyptian development invokes and reproduces this effect.
zh: 这些本质上属于语言、意象、空间和运动的实践安排，大多起源极近，正如我在本书前面几章所探讨的。
我们倾向于把它们看作只是标出和再现民族国家的过程，仿佛民族国家本身有某种先于这些过程的现实。事实上，民族国家正是由所有这些日常管制和再现形式所产生的效果，这些形式使它以经验对象的外观被建立起来。那么多埃及发展研究开篇所用的尼罗河及其居民的地理意象，正是在唤起并复制这一效果。

en: model answers
zh: 标准答案

en: There are two consequences of the way economics takes for granted the nation-state as its object. The first is the illusion of the model. Portrayed as a freestanding entity rather than a particular position within a larger arrangement of transnational economic and political forces, an individual nation-state appears to be a functional unit—something akin to a car, say, or a mechanical pump—that can be compared with and used as a model for improving other such units. This supposed comparability is emphasized by the annual volumes of statistics produced by the World Bank and other international development agencies. Economic features of one state appear to be neatly transferable to other states, without regard for their different position in larger economic and historical networks.
zh: 经济学把民族国家当作其对象，这带来两个后果。第一个是模型的幻觉。一个单独的民族国家被描绘成一个自由独立的实体，而不是跨国经济和政治力量更大配置中的一个特定位置，于是它显得像一个功能单位——类似于一辆汽车，比如说，或一台机械泵——可以与其他同类单位比较，并被用作改进它们的模型。世界银行和其他国际发展机构每年出版的统计年鉴强调了这种所谓的可比性。一个国家的经济特征似乎可以整齐地转移到其他国家，而不考虑它们在更大经济和历史网络中的不同位置。

en: The example of this in Egypt’s case is the way agencies like the IMF and USAID began to promote the growth of exports as the solution to the country’s economic problems. Egypt was to develop the export of winter vegetables and cut flowers to markets in Europe and the Gulf, along with textiles and possibly other light manufactured goods, in order to earn the hard currency to keep up interest payments on its foreign debts. The idea was that Egypt and similar countries should follow the path of the newly industrialized countries of East Asia—Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea.
zh: 在埃及的例子中，这一点体现在国际货币基金组织和美国国际开发署等机构开始把促进出口作为该国经济问题的解决办法。埃及要发展向欧洲和海湾市场的冬季蔬菜和切花出口，以及纺织品和可能的其他轻工制成品，以赚取硬通货来维持外债利息支付。其想法是，埃及和类似国家应走东亚新兴工业化国家——新加坡、香港、台湾和韩国——的道路。

en: This notion that solutions from East Asia provided a model for other Third World states was curious.

Egypt’s merchandise exports in 1987 amounted to less than one-fifth of one percent of world trade. More than two-thirds of this merchandise consisted of oil, the supply of which was expected to decline in coming decades.
